promises.quote: All patients presenting with symptoms of mental illness/mental disorder and/or after reported self harm/suicidal behaviour will now be automatically referred for a mental health assessment to be conducted as soon as possible whether that referral is from A&E or any ward. Pending that assessment mental health staff can give advice by phone concerning the patient's interim care and management.
promises.summary: Automatic referral for mental health assessment upon presentation of symptoms or self-harm, with phone advice pending assessment
